ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85:15 ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity band along the trailing edge; several distinct circular and ring-like black pixel clusters distributed across the central white field; one large curvilinear 'hook' shape on the distal left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a central vertex angle of approximately 90 degrees and significant bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying pixel amplitudes (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge boundary, most pronounced on the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves sweeping from the median notch to the outer tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and ring-shaped high-contrast dark pixel clusters observed mid-left lobe and mid-right lobe (potential barnacle attachment sites).
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Series of roughly five parallel, vertically-oriented dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the distal right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent dark rake marks on the right lobe; large irregular dark pigmentation mark on the outer left lobe tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized area of yellowish-brown pigmentation immediately adjacent to the left side of the median notch.
